page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.2xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by AWS Graviton ARM64 processors. It features 8 dedicated physical cores operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, which is managed via the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

For local storage, the r9gd.2xlarge includes a bundled 474 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume. This local storage provides high-speed, low-latency read and write capabilities directly attached to the host. The network architecture delivers a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture of the AWS Graviton processor combined with a high memory density offers a favorable resource-to-cost ratio for memory-bound applications compared to traditional x86 alternatives. The inclusion of local NVMe SSD storage reduces the need for external block storage for temporary data. This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive workloads, including distributed databases, in-memory caches, real-time analytics, and data processing pipelines that require rapid local scratch space.
